{"bugs_found": ["seq() raises ValueError whenever any parser is supplied: the guard `if parsers or kw_parsers: raise ValueError(...)` triggers for the legal positional-only and keyword-only cases; the contract only forbids mixing the two, so the condition should be `if parsers and kw_parsers`. This makes seq unusable and breaks every dependent combinator (then, skip, __add__, etc.)."], "verdict": "REQUEST_CHANGES"}
